title: Say Managtawag manlapud Kaaraleman
intro: Isipen pa so sakey a kamarerwa ya inmatalek ed sakey a madibinon mensahe, balet ta sakey ya, diad sakey a bekta na inkaapura, et tinmaynan ed saray totoo to ya anggapoy malinew ya permiso. Sayan biahe so angitonton ed sikara ed nikadkaduman subok, sakey a baleg a subok ed anos tan panagmatalek ed Sankatageyan. Siopa iyan indibidual ya say istorya to so mangibabangat ed sikatayo nipaakar ed panagbabawi tan say kalaknab na panangasi nen Allah?
clues: Nibaki ak ed sakey a baleg a bansa, balet say inmunan impangipulisay da et sengegay gonigon ko.
Tinaynan ko ray totook, ya manisia ak ya asumpal lay misyon ko, antis ak ya akaawat na malinew ya ganggan ya ontaynan ak.
Nananap ak na luluganan ed sakey a barko, balet lapud maksil a bagyo tan say panagpalaranan so angitonton ed makapasinagem a situasyon.
Nibantak ak ed dayat, tan inakmon ak na sakey a makapanyarin pinalsa ed kaaralman.
Diad kabilungetan na eges to, tinmawag ak ed si Allah, ya inaksobi koy lingok tan kinmerew ak na panamerdona To.
Ingganggan nen Allah so pinalsa ya ipelag to ak ed gilig na dayat, tan pinmawil so bunigas ko ed silong na sakey a nikadkaduman tanaman.

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Say inakmon na baleg a sira
Say paneral ed sakey a syudad lapud saray bato
trial.answer: Say inakmon na baleg a sira

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Pinmawil pian igiya so magbabawin bansa
Niiter so pakauley ed saray jinn
Inwanwan to ray totoo ed desierto
outcome.answer: Pinmawil pian igiya so magbabawin bansa

verse: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy. (37:142)
